summary: Mary Jones, 54, of Rogersville, MO, died after falling from a small cliff/rock embankment while apparently taking a late-night walk near Pine Creek Road by Curecanti Dam; she had stopped for the night while traveling alone through the area; remains discovered by an NPS officer
location: Pine Creek Road near Curecanti Dam, Blue Mesa Reservoir, Curecanti National Recreation Area
responding_agency: NPS Curecanti NRA; Gunnison County Sheriff's Office
notes: Date: Friday 2018-01-05 (weekday-verified; article published 2018-01-10 states 'Friday, January 5'). Unattended-death investigation by NPS officers and Gunnison County sheriff's officers; no SAR search mission — body discovered by NPS officer. Inserted per the indexed unattended-death-recovery precedent (e.g. COLM id 3011).
